ios.desc:
YardSard is the yard sale app that keeps you organized so you can focus on selling.

Set up your inventory, run your sale, and track everything in one place, without spreadsheets, sticky notes, or guesswork.

• Simple inventory — Add items, set prices, and organize with categories. See your entire sale at a glance.
• Record sales fast — Check out one item or build a multi-item cart, then log sales quickly so you always know what's sold, what's left, and how you're doing. Create a photo receipt for any recorded sale to share, save, or print. 
• Get paid faster — Link your Venmo, PayPal, or Cash App username, and the app will automatically generate a QR code for each item, so that buyers can scan and pay instantly with the amount pre-filled.
• Manage your YardSards — Create and manage multiple sale events, track totals, and keep each event organized from start to finish.
• Nearby public listings — Premium users can share events through a link or QR code, even with people who don't have the app. Keep an event link-only, or publish it to Nearby so local buyers can discover it. Share an approximate area for privacy, or an exact address for directions. 
• Stay synced and backed up — Premium includes cloud backup, syncing across devices, restore tools, and additional export options.
• Works your way — Use the app as a guest, or sign in with Apple or Google to save your data and unlock premium features.

Whether you’re running a weekend garage sale, an estate sale, or a multi-day neighborhood event, YardSard helps you stay on top of inventory and sales so you can run a smoother, less stressful sale.

YardSard is free to download and use. We offer optional auto-renewing subscriptions (“Premium”) that unlock advanced features including cloud backup, device syncing, shareable event links and QR codes, public Nearby listings, detailed CSV and summary PDF exports, and restore tools. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID account settings.

Download YardSard and make your next yard sale your easiest one yet.

quotes.text:
(Started working on this 11 months ago, HN comment from 8 ago!: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=44702833#44711006)

Inspired by my wife yelling "YARDSARD" every time we drive past a yard sale sign (and us having way too many knickknacks at home that I'm trying to get rid of): YardSard is a simple inventory tool built for yard/garage/estate/etc sales. This is my first non-pivot-or-quit app launch, & I've tried really hard to make it a useful experience for when someone actually walks up to you and is ready to buy your old GameCube game or t-shirt.

To keep this short: YardSard lets you create multiple sale "events", categories, items, etc. You can link external payment app usernames to make it easy for sellers to scan auto-generated QR codes that pre-fill item name/price/description on their end (this app doesn't handle any of the actual transactions between you + buyer), post-sale analytics.

There are 3 tiers. Guest (no account needed, local-first, local-only, slightly limited usage ["try before you commit" type thing]), Free (account via Apple/Google -- generous usage; unlimited items, events, etc.), and Premium (power user: cloud sync between multiple devices in real-time, backups, advanced exports, restoring deleted items/categories).
